test.result: 49 passed (exit code 0); Ruff and mypy on the new futures paper module passed.

implemented: A durable single-currency futures paper account accepts owner-supplied contract terms with source identifiers and SHA-256 provenance; no Indian exchange lot, tick, multiplier or margin constants are hardcoded.

Signed lot-sized trades, daily cash variation settlement, margin availability and maintenance-call status, expiry settlement, and atomic same-root later-expiry rolls are journaled and rebuilt through the existing hash-chained durable journal and double-entry ledger.

Event IDs are idempotent and bind to request content; insufficient initial margin, stale dates, incompatible roll lot sizes, invalid ticks, and conflicting retries are rejected without committing state.
Restart reproduces position, cash and variation P&L; focused futures and accounting regression suite passes.
blockers: Contract/price source hashes are required but are not independently validated against official exchange or Kite source artifacts; authenticated contract-master ingestion is not wired.
The futures account is not yet registered in the shared multi-book portfolio, live forward session runner, strategy adapters, or evidence package pipeline.

The paper model does not charge brokerage, exchange charges, taxes, slippage, funding or settlement costs, and maintenance breach only reports a margin-call state; it does not model broker liquidation or recovery.
No prospective market-session cohort or observed fills establish execution assumptions or profitability.
scope_note: This is a paper-only accounting component for a single open futures contract and is not a broker execution path, official margin calculator, or profitability claim.
